abstract_sentences.text: Recently, the frontier of Large Language Model (LLM) capabilities has shifted from single-turn code generation to agentic software engineering—a paradigm where models autonomously navigate, edit, and test complex repositories.
abstract_sentences.comparison: single-turn code generation versus agentic software engineering

evidence.anchor: shifted from single-turn code generation to agentic software engineering

abstract_sentences.text: While post-training methods have become the de facto approach for code agents, agentic mid-training—mid-training (MT) on large-scale data that mirrors authentic agentic workflows—remains critically underexplored due to substantial resource requirements, despite offering a more scalable path to instilling foundational agentic behaviors than relying solely on expensive reinforcement learning.
abstract_sentences.relation: turns the scope into a gap and cost constraint

evidence.anchor: agentic mid-training remains critically underexplored due to substantial resource requirements

abstract_sentences.text: A central challenge in realizing effective agentic mid-training is the distribution mismatch between static training data and the dynamic, feedback-rich environment of real development.
abstract_sentences.comparison: static training data versus dynamic feedback-rich development

evidence.anchor: distribution mismatch between static training data and the dynamic, feedback-rich environment

abstract_sentences.text: To address this, we present a systematic study of agentic mid-training, establishing both the data synthesis principles and training methodology for effective agent development at scale.
abstract_sentences.relation: answers the distribution-mismatch problem with a study and recipe

evidence.anchor: establishing both the data synthesis principles and training methodology

abstract_sentences.text: Central to our approach is agent-native data—supervision comprising two complementary types of trajectories: contextually-native trajectories that preserve the complete information flow an agent experiences, offering broad coverage and diversity; and environmentally-native trajectories collected from executable repositories where observations stem from actual tool invocations and test executions, providing depth and interaction authenticity.
abstract_sentences.relation: instantiates the central idea as two mechanisms

evidence.anchor: two complementary types of trajectories

abstract_sentences.text: We verify the model’s agentic capabilities on SWE-Bench Verified.

evidence.anchor: verify the model’s agentic capabilities on SWE-Bench Verified

abstract_sentences.text: We demonstrate our superiority over the previous open software engineering mid-training recipe Kimi-Dev under two post-training settings with an aligned base model and agentic scaffold, while using less than half mid-training tokens (73.1B).
abstract_sentences.relation: gives relative advantage and token budget

evidence.anchor: superiority over the previous open software engineering mid-training recipe Kimi-Dev

abstract_sentences.text: Besides relative advantage, our best performing 32B and 72B models achieve 56.1% and 58.5% resolution rates, respectively, which are state-of-the-art among open training recipes using agentic scaffolds under their model sizes, despite starting from non-coder Qwen2.5-Base base models.
qualifiers: state-of-the-art among open training recipes using agentic scaffolds under their model sizes
abstract_sentences.comparison: open agentic-scaffold recipes at corresponding model sizes
abstract_sentences.relation: turns relative advantage into size-specific absolute scores

evidence.anchor: 32B and 72B models achieve 56.1% and 58.5% resolution rates

abstract_sentences.text: Beyond these agentic capabilities, we also observe performance gains on general code generation and scientific benchmarks.
abstract_sentences.comparison: general code/scientific benchmarks versus base models
abstract_sentences.relation: extends the result beyond SWE tasks

evidence.anchor: performance gains on general code generation and scientific benchmarks

abstract_sentences.text: We plan to open-source a significant portion of our datasets, recipes, and model checkpoints—resources representing substantial computational investment typically unavailable to the broader community—to facilitate further research in this underexplored paradigm.
abstract_sentences.relation: closes with a future resource/impact claim

evidence.anchor: plan to open-source a significant portion of our datasets, recipes, and model checkpoints

introduction_moves.current_answer: Repository-level agentic software engineering requires autonomous navigation, cross-file understanding, editing and test validation.
introduction_moves.next_hook: The dominant construction route is SFT followed by RL, with limited data.

evidence.anchor: expanded from synthesizing isolated functions to tackling repository-level software engineering tasks

introduction_moves.previous_question: Why is the dominant post-training route insufficient?
introduction_moves.current_answer: Executable repositories are limited, expert trajectories are expensive, correct-only filtering constrains data, and post-training is bounded by base-model capacity.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Can foundational agentic behaviors be instilled during mid-training?

evidence.anchor: the quantity and diversity are limited for the repositories that can be used in this paradigm

introduction_moves.previous_question: What is missing from existing code MT?
introduction_moves.current_answer: Factorized localization/editing samples omit the procedural context an agent sees before acting.
introduction_moves.next_hook: The mismatch should be framed as a missing action–observation loop.

evidence.anchor: without the procedural context that an agent would encounter before exercising these capabilities

introduction_moves.previous_question: Why does a static PR snapshot fail at deployment?
introduction_moves.current_answer: Commit history hides discovery, inspected context and test-driven revisions; agents need a coherent localize→read→edit→test→revise loop.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Define two complementary forms of agent-native supervision.

evidence.anchor: coordinate these skills into a coherent, iterative problem-solving loop

introduction_moves.previous_question: How can coverage and diversity be preserved?
introduction_moves.current_answer: Contextually-native trajectories bind localization, relevant files, edits and interleaved textual reasoning in full task sequences.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Authentic execution feedback requires a second trajectory type.

evidence.anchor: emphasizes coverage and diversity

introduction_moves.previous_question: How can dynamic interaction be preserved?
introduction_moves.current_answer: Environmentally-native trajectories come from real tool/test interactions, preserve errors and feedback, and are not filtered to correct-only rollouts.
introduction_moves.next_hook: Instantiate both types from GitHub PR elements.

evidence.anchor: prioritizes interaction authenticity

introduction_moves.previous_question: Does the proposed data scale and improve SWE?
introduction_moves.current_answer: The preview reports 68.6B Dctx, 3.1B Denv, 73.1B total MT, 56.1% at 32B and 58.5% at 72B, plus broader benchmark gains.
introduction_moves.next_hook: State the two contributions and enter formal setup.

evidence.anchor: reducing the mid-training corpus size by over 50% (73.1B vs ∼150B tokens)

introduction_moves.previous_question: What is claimed as the contribution?
introduction_moves.current_answer: The first contribution defines agentic MT/data and corpora; the second claims gains across post-training schemes and scales with robustness, scalability and generalization analysis.

evidence.anchor: We formulate agentic mid-training and introduce agent-native data

related_work_moves.topic: Mid-training as a bridge; Kimi-Dev has isolated retrieval/editing rather than an end-to-end process.

evidence.anchor: these behaviors are treated in isolation and do not constitute a coherent, end-to-end agentic process

related_work_moves.topic: SFT/RL and environment rollouts lead to code-agent data; systematic agentic MT remains scarce.

evidence.anchor: systematic studies of agentic mid-training remain notably scarce

related_work_moves.topic: Synthetic data moves from corpus rewriting to personas and interactive process synthesis; MT synthesis is positioned as a bridge.

evidence.anchor: synthetic data has shifted from text-level generation to the synthesis of agentic processes

method_moves.description: Define task tuple (R,q,E), policy πθ, observation generator Obs, and history h.

evidence.anchor: We formalize an agentic software engineering task as a tuple (R, q, E)

method_moves.description: Explain why repository-scale tasks require iterative tool interaction and feedback.

evidence.anchor: must iteratively refine its solution based on feedback from the evaluation oracle

method_moves.description: Name the typical localize→read→edit→test→revise workflow and binary success label y.

evidence.anchor: localize (identifying relevant files) → read (understanding code context) → edit

method_moves.description: Use distribution mismatch to contrast static final artifacts with deployment action–observation pairs.

evidence.anchor: without the sequential action-observation pairs (a_t, o_t) that agents experience at deployment

method_moves.description: Frame Dctx as breadth/context and Denv as depth/authentic execution dynamics.

evidence.anchor: The combination ensures both breadth (diverse workflow patterns at scale) and depth (authentic execution dynamics)

method_moves.description: Define contextually-native PR reconstruction: issue, relevant files and sequential edits in one sample.

evidence.anchor: we keep all relevant information together—issue description, relevant repository files, and modifications

method_moves.description: Instantiate the contextually-native pipeline through collection, filtering, content enhancement, file identification and template organization; no pseudocode algorithm is used.

evidence.anchor: Template organization. We organize all extracted information into clearly delineated sections

method_moves.description: Claim that relevant paths, file contents and edits mirror localize/read/edit and reduce train-test mismatch.

evidence.anchor: This organization mirrors the workflow: relevant file paths simulates the ‘localize’ phase

method_moves.description: Contrast contextually-native structure with simulated/read-only trajectories that lack test feedback.

evidence.anchor: they lack agentic feedback—the model never observes how its edits affect test outcomes

method_moves.description: Build executable Docker tasks, roll out GLM-4.6 in SWE-AGENT, split pass/fail trajectories, and hand the corpus to MT/SFT experiments.

evidence.anchor: For each task, we generate up to 4 rollouts

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 agentic SWE 的训练目标从独立技能或最终 patch 改为保留完整信息流的 agent-native mid-training：Dctx 提供跨仓库 context breadth，Denv 提供真实 execution-feedback depth，二者共同改善 agentic SFT。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 任务 formalization、localize→read→edit→test→revise loop、两类数据及规模、SWE-AGENT/模型设定、Tables 1–4、Figure 4，以及 patched evaluator、single-family/benchmark 和 privacy 限制。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: staging、batch/LR/mask、LLM prompts、General/Python format、13-gram contamination rule 和 24 个被移除实例移入 Appendix A–D；迁移压缩正文但增加复现依赖。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 先把 factorization 的 train-test mismatch 与两种 agent-native data 的角色可视化；Table 1 做 scale/SFT 对照，Table 4 再拆 PR grounding 与 MT trajectory value。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 没有同格式但去掉真实 execution feedback 的严格控制，也没有 summary/review/commit order/test feedback 的组件消融；seed、硬件、成本、task-level uncertainty 与跨 family evaluation 也缺失。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 若主张对象是 agentic workflow，应把决策前 context、action、真实 observation 与 revision 放进同一可追踪链，并用结构对照和最小成分消融分别证明为何失配、哪类信息改变结果。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适用于有可观测工具调用/环境反馈且需要长程状态更新的代码或工具任务；单轮、上下文已完整或没有可验证 execution oracle 的任务不能直接外推同样收益。

evidence_coverage.basis: 所有 abstract、introduction、method、design、result、ablation、limitation、closure 与 final-judgment 判断均在 Markdown/JSON 中附物理页、章节和短锚点或图表/公式编号。
